name: ScrollFloat-TS-TW
blurb: Characters float up and scale in as they scroll into view, with staggered timing.
description: Splits text into characters and animates each to float upward with scale and opacity changes as the element scrolls into view. Uses GSAP ScrollTrigger to sync animation with scroll position.
use_when: Body text or headings need an elegant reveal effect that's tied to scroll progress.
avoid_when: When text must be readable immediately without scrolling to reveal.
a11y: Text is split into character spans with opacity animation. Readable but animation may distract from content.
